CPlay for Windows bundles these components:

- Qt 6.8.2 (LGPL-3.0) - https://www.qt.io/ - unmodified DLLs, replaceable by the user.
- libmpv (mpv) and FFmpeg as built by shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake (GPL-3.0 build)
  - https://mpv.io/ , https://ffmpeg.org/ , https://github.com/shinchiro/mpv-winbuild-cmake
  Because this build of libmpv is GPL, CPlay for Windows is distributed under
  GPL-3.0-compatible terms; its source code is available on request.
- Vulkan loader (Apache-2.0) - https://github.com/KhronosGroup/Vulkan-Loader
- Material Icons font (Apache-2.0) - https://github.com/google/material-design-icons
- llvm-mingw C++ runtime: libc++ / libunwind (Apache-2.0 WITH LLVM-exception)
- Mesa llvmpipe as opengl32sw.dll (MIT), shipped by Qt as a software OpenGL fallback
